source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The patch titled comment clarification also disables a signature-mismatch assertion. The fixed test directly checks that two body fragments remain visible and that the encrypted icon is absent. Its MIME headers claim an encrypted message while the content is signed. Signature validity is a separate, explicitly uncertain result in the comment; a commented-out assertion is not coverage. Read the actual assertion change before classifying a patch as documentation only. No OpenPGP message task ran.
title: The Git commit spoof test directly checks encryption display rather than signature mismatch
